'''Trell'yar''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Bothan/Legends|Bothan]], who served the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Biography==
Trell'yar served the Rebel Alliance as a [[Spy/Legends|spy]] and was among a group of Bothan spies who helped to discover the location of the [[Death Star II/Legends|second Death Star]]. By [[7 ABY/Legends|7 ABY]], evidence had emerged that Trell'yar was an agent of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], so the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] placed a [[Bounty/Legends|bounty]] on his head. [[General/Legends|General]] [[Airen Cracken/Legends|Airen Cracken]] found the charges against Trell'yar hard to believe and [[Council]]or [[Borsk Fey'lya]] openly stated that be believed that the charges were false.
